description: Diagnostic to assess why permission_scope_enrichment_v2, temporal_stability_enrichment_v2, and tool_description_safety_enrichment_v2 produce only 4 distinct scores (signal diagnostic shows plateau at 4 values). Query mcp_signal_enrichments for rows where signal_type in ('permission_scope','temporal_stability','tool_description_safety'), collect all score values, assert cardinality >= 20 per spec section 3 enricher contract. Report which fields the enrichment modules read vs. the metadata available. Output is a diagnostic report only — no DB writes, no module changes.
